basic_info.description: A great house at an excellent location in a nice neighborhood in the inner sunset. 2 blocks to Golden Gate park. Walk to UCSF medical center, UCSF shuttle stops, supermarkets, restaurants, etc. Over the years owner has spent about one million dollars total upgrading the house from top to bottom: kitchen with granite countertops, tile floor, quality appliances; bathrooms with marbles; quality hardwood floors in dining room, living room and 3rd floor bedrooms; custom wood windows in living room and front bedrooms; brand new carpet in the junior master bedroom; all lightings replaced; redesigned backyard with custom French drain and beautiful garden; laundry room and exercise room remodeled; brand new epoxy coated garage floor; solar panels owned and was contracted with PG&E for extra power reimbursement; air duct, vent and water heater replaced; outside kitchen deck and staircase rebuilt; brand new roof with 20 year warranty. 2-car tandem garage with storage cabinets, spacious room for bikes. The security system, Refrigerator (2-year new), washer/dryer (still in warranty), dining room set and beds stay.  This house is comfortable, beautiful and practical.  Backyard is 60 feet long - ample room to build ADU or expand the house.  Move-in ready. It is a good bargain at this price.
